note: Owner civil-liberties priority list (2026-11-17). Keys are AGENCY or AGENCY/COMPONENT abbreviations, matched by slug against directory component IDs; verify abbreviations against the FOIA.gov snapshot. Unlisted agencies are tier 3. Tier 1 defaults to a monthly cadence, tiers 2-3 to quarterly.

CIA.reason: Foreign intelligence agency with domestic-surveillance history; publishes no FOIA log, so it is always requested

DOD/NSA.reason: Signals intelligence and bulk-collection programs (listed as a DoD component on FOIA.gov)

ODNI.reason: Oversees the intelligence community and its surveillance authorities

DOJ/DEA.reason: Drug enforcement surveillance and data programs

DOJ/BOP.reason: Federal prison conditions and treatment of prisoners

DOJ/USMS.reason: Fugitive operations, prisoner custody and surveillance technology

DOJ/CRT.reason: Civil Rights Division enforcement of civil-rights laws

DHS.reason: Immigration enforcement, border searches and domestic intelligence

DHS/CBP.reason: Border searches, device searches and surveillance

DHS/IA.reason: DHS Office of Intelligence and Analysis domestic intelligence

DOS.reason: State Department visa, passport and diplomatic records affecting rights abroad

TREAS/IRS.reason: Tax enforcement and targeting of organizations

USPS/USPIS.reason: Postal Inspection Service investigations and mail covers

FCC.reason: Communications regulation, surveillance and press-related matters

ED/OCR.reason: Education Office for Civil Rights complaints and enforcement

HHS.reason: Health privacy, public-health powers and benefits

SSA.reason: Benefits records and data sharing with enforcement agencies
